section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Image-Acceptance and Action Questionnaire (BI-AAQ), a 12-item measure of body image flexibility that participants completed. The BI-AAQ uses a 7-point scale with reverse-scored items, and the present sample achieved an internal consistency alpha of .92. The section references prior validation studies with U.S. college students and Portuguese adults, as well as eating disorder patients, but does not provide specific demographic or outcome data for the present study sample.
